cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Can you approve 'delivery delay' in the newsletter? I don't want our new volunteer blamed for the melted cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She delivered it on time. We left it by the radiator.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then 'storage problem'. Will you approve that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if we mention the refund.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. 'Storage problem; full refund arranged.' Can I put your name under it?

cardFidelity.evidence: B2 supplies the factual correction to A's delivery story; A3 professional lecture claims expertise without doing any professional evaluation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 true cause prompts A3 storage wording; B4 refund requirement prompts A5 revised text. The standard sentence is unrelated to these changes.

relationship.evidence: B2 protects the volunteer from a false delivery claim and B4 wants customers told about compensation.

heightening.evidence: A5 adds B4 refund condition to secure signature, clearly serving D124 but not S03 distinctively.

specificity.evidence: A1 newsletter, melted cake and volunteer blame plus B2 radiator give concrete public-account stakes.
